launches.title: Repovive: Enabling AI to formally verify chips and critical software
launches.tagline: Enabling AI models to formally verify the chips and code the world runs on
launches.body:
Hey YC! We’re Shayan and Amir, co-founders of Repovive. We’re enabling AI models to formally verify the chips and code the world runs on.

A flaw in a chip design can be expensive to fix after fabrication. A bug in critical software can expose the infrastructure we depend on. Formal proofs can establish that a system meets its specifications, but constructing them takes specialized expertise and substantial manual work. Teams often rely on tests that cover selected scenarios, leaving gaps where failures can go undetected.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CL_-F3LWi34>

**Today, we provide AI labs with formalization data and reinforcement learning environments in Lean for model training and evaluation.** Lean is a proof assistant for writing and checking mathematical proofs. Our non-public Lean tasks come with formally verified reference proofs, giving labs difficult problems for training and a rigorous way to evaluate whether models can solve them.

We’re already working with AI labs and have closed **$100k in contracts in just the past month**. Our team includes Olympiad medalists, PhD researchers, and former Google engineers, with research published at NeurIPS, ICLR, and IJCAI.

This work lays the foundation for our larger ambition, **a black box for formal verification**. You specify what needs to be proven, and the system does the work of finding a proof. Any proof it returns can be independently and formally verified. Our goal is to make formal verification practical enough to become a standard step in chip design, critical software development, and mathematical research.

**We’d love introductions to**

* AI researchers and post-training teams sourcing formalization data or reinforcement learning environments.
* Engineers and researchers tackling difficult verification problems in chip design, critical software, or mathematics.

We’re happy to share samples of our Lean tasks and learn more about what your team is working on. Reach us at [founders@repovive.com](mailto:founders@repovive.com).
